name: Alex Karp
current_role: Co-founder and CEO of Palantir Technologies
summary: Alex Karp co-founded the data-analytics and defense software company Palantir with Peter Thiel and others and has been its CEO since the company's early years. Raised in a left-leaning household and once a Trump critic, he gave $1 million to Trump's 2025 inaugural committee and has publicly praised Trump's border and national-security policies while Palantir's U.S. government business, including immigration-enforcement work for ICE, has grown sharply.

connections.name: Peter Thiel
connections.description: Co-founded Palantir in 2003; Karp has been CEO since 2005 and Thiel chairman since 2003.

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: Once critical of Trump, Karp wrote a $1 million check to the Trump-Vance Inaugural Committee and has since praised Trump on border and national security, calling him "a peace president" and backing strikes on suspected drug boats. Palantir's U.S. government revenue rose sharply under the administration, including a 2025 ICE contract.
